## Checklist (a task is done only when all of these are true)
- [ ] It is on a branch and merges into `main` through this pull request
- [ ] It has tests in `tests/` (ok programs with `.out`, error programs with `# expect:`)
- [ ] `make test` passes
- [ ] One other team member has reviewed it
- [ ] If it changes a contract (ast.h, rt.h, error format, command line) the group has been told
- [ ] If it changes the language, the proposal in `docs/` was updated first
